experimental_contract: The published JUNO normal-ordering fit and Daya Bay small theta13 branch calibrate the mixing amplitudes conditionally. A reflected model maps the whole propagation Hamiltonian, including Earth's term and atmospheric spectrum. The two branches are not separately published JUNO intervals. Work boxes add SNO errors linearly. No joint likelihood.
holdout: SNO daylight zeroth-order polynomial coefficient at 10 MeV, active-only CC, NC, ES response; independent of listed reactor data. Standard production and detection, separable atmospheric mode and adiabatic decohered solar doublet; any additional prediction/extraction error is addressed separately.
